# CourtLens expected shots: retrospective research

Status: selection_failed_negative_result.

Location/type logistic model versus a training-only zone/type Beta(1,1) baseline. Three complete reconciled regular seasons; two official supplemental attempts have no admitted geometry and are excluded. 2023-24 trains, 2024-25 selects/calibrates by frozen game-date halves, and 2025-26 is a previously exposed retrospective report. No prospective validation or vendor-equivalent claim. Free throws, foul value, tracking, defender proximity and player identity are absent.

Candidate fits: 1. Final report opened: False. A failed selection stops before calibration/final errors. Exact memberships, predictions, metrics and kernel resource accounting accompany this report. No active points policy or historical profile changes.


Selection Brier improvement: 0.08126656%. Registered minimum: 1%. Fit through: 2024-04-14; report through: 2025-01-15. Calibration fit performed: False.

Protocol: `ce40518f8eebe240db250b60890df1a9f104e442559ce494a77c57cc0e47e805`. Binding: `78e9ea2a5365206485610dcbfdffd21826f71d6518072bc332dbd9785bc10ad7`. Dataset: `3d64fe04-dc9a-4a45-bf96-182371a94f7b` / `680f8291296f2f3c52758ece1678c5be0fae0f5431dfce2ad41780a4dcd06e19`. Sources: NBA Stats via the pinned shufinskiy/nba_data archive (Apache 2.0 notices retained); independent SportsDataverse schedule/boxes (CC BY 4.0 attribution retained); retained official NBA observations for reviewed corrections. Local noncommercial research; raw-source redistribution is independently gated.

This append-only package derives separate predictions, exclusion records and configuration metadata from the sealed run and admitted inputs. No new fit or error evaluation.

baseline_configurations: Beta(1,1) smoothed training make rate by shot-zones-v1 zone and 2/3 type. Unseen cell falls back to training type rate, then league rate; all references training-only.
worker.calibration_configuration: Within validation season split unique game dates at median date: earlier half selects candidate against baseline, later half fits intercept-only logit calibration. Do not refit on validation. Final predictions frozen after calibration; calibration needs >=1000 attempts and both outcomes, otherwise fail. Probabilities clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6] only for log-loss.
candidate_configurations: One logistic location/type model C=1; one intercept-only logit calibration on validation tail after selection.
worker.preprocessing_configuration: Fit vocabularies, centering, scaling and reference rates on training only. Unknown validation/final players get zero coefficient plus unsupported flag; no future identity or full-season prior enters an earlier prediction.
